reason: A DeepSeek Harness sidebar plugin primarily focused on monitoring API balance, daily spending, token usage, and pricing periods, with recharge refresh and one-click local Harness restart features.

summaries.zh: 用于在 DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏监控 API 余额、每日费用、令牌用量和峰谷价格，并提供充值刷新与一键重启功能。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness sidebar plugin for monitoring API balance, daily costs, token usage, and peak or off-peak pricing, with recharge refresh and one-click restart controls.

capabilities: Reads DeepSeek API balance and usage data
Tracks daily cost, token usage, and peak/off-peak pricing status
Persists local balance and daily usage state
Opens the official DeepSeek recharge page
Restarts the current Harness through a local supervisor
